result.title: Toward a Compositional Knowledge Architecture for a Shared Organizational Cortex
result.comment: 25 pages, 10 figures, 10 tables. Evaluation and sources in https://github.com/withrobinhq/geometric-knowledge-paper-evals (tag registered-plan)
result.summary: Organizations accumulate evidence in conversations, documents, decisions and relationships, but they act on interpretations: judgements assembled from several observations, resting on assumptions, and revised as circumstances change. Existing retrieval, knowledge graphs and agent memory keep the records and lose the interpretation. We propose a four-layer architecture, Signals, Domains, Claims and Dimensions, in which interpretations persist with their justifications and standing, a truth-maintenance network revises that standing as evidence changes, and validated, versioned Dimensions position interpretations on named axes. We call the result a shared organizational cortex. In a registered retrieval experiment, the Dimension term gains 0.028 nDCG@10 (p = 0.002). In system-level comparisons, the full retrieval configuration improves nDCG@10 by 0.081 over Signals-only and 0.053 over graph-augmented Signals-only retrieval (both reported p < 0.001). The architecture gives organizations a persistent, revisable basis for shared judgement.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Signals、Domains、Claims、Dimensions 四层组织知识架构，用真值维护网络随证据变化修订解释的成立状态，并在检索实验中报告 Dimension 项与完整配置的 nDCG@10 提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把解释连同依据一起持久保存、并随新证据修订信念状态的做法，可能与 LVR 中多步视觉证据整合后的内部状态更新和证据筛选形成概念类比，可供核查；但属组织知识管理场景，与 VLM 推理无直接实验联系。
